core_obligations: Everything is local; reduce to X = Spec(A) -> S = Spec(R) affine with E corresponding to K in D(A) via the declared affine-local input.
For s corresponding to the prime p, the derived pullback to the fibre corresponds to K tensor^L_R kappa(p), since R -> A is flat (base-change comparison).
Apply the module-level criterion: K is relatively perfect over R iff K is bounded below and K tensor kappa(p) is bounded below for every p; translate back to the geometric statement.
proof_roadmap: Affine reduction; fibre identification; module criterion; translation back.
difficulty_reason: A reduction argument: the content is the fibre identification plus the translation into the named algebra criterion.
